title: Add 9 missing Church-approved Marian apparitions to dataset
description: Research confirmed the current 14-apparition dataset is missing 9 formally approved apparitions: Our Lady of the Pillar/Zaragoza (Spain, 40 AD, papal approval 1723), Our Lady of Cotignac (France, 1519), Our Lady of Siluva (Lithuania, 1608, papal decree 1775), Our Lady of Laus (France, 1664, Vatican 2008), Our Lady of the Tears/Syracuse (Italy, 1953, Pope Pius XII), Our Lady of Betania (Venezuela, 1976, bishop 1987), Our Lady of Cuapa (Nicaragua, 1980, bishop 1982), Our Lady Rosa Mystica/Montichiari (Italy, 1947, Vatican 2024), Our Lady of the Rosary of San Nicolás (Argentina, 1983, bishop 2016). All need to be added to src/data/apparitions.ts with coordinates, source URLs, and AI-quality summaries matching the style of existing entries.
close_reason: All 9 missing apparitions added to src/data/apparitions.ts. Dataset expanded from 14 to 23 entries. Build passes cleanly.
